name: Jiao Cang
overview: Jiang Shu, a woman born with a rare healing body, becomes a pawn in a deadly struggle when Prince Shen Xiuyan seeks her to save his life from a lethal poison. Caught between betrayal, desire, and political intrigue, Jiang Shu and Shen Xiuyan form a fateful bond that leads them to defy the empire and fight for love at the edge of life and death.
